issues.description: In the template for Exercise 5 (ex5_grover_kakuro.py) the attribute number_of_qubits_query_register is declared as a float (0.0). This is structurally incorrect because QuantumRegister expects an integer number of qubits. The problem statement and the solution both treat the query register size as an integer (the problem describes a 2×2 Kakuro with 4 binary variables; the solution sets this attribute to 4). As written, the template will raise a type error when constructing the QuantumRegister and will prevent students from instantiating the class or running any code, blocking progress.
issues.suggested_fix: Change number_of_qubits_query_register from a float to an integer. For example, set it to an integer placeholder (0) if you want students to fill it in: number_of_qubits_query_register = 0  # ### FILL IN NUMBER OF QUBITS ###. Or set it to the intended value for the exercise (4) to match the solution: number_of_qubits_query_register = 4. Ensure the type is int so QuantumRegister(...) can be constructed without error.
